sentences: G: I’d like a banana smoothie, please.
M: For here or to go?
And can you please put it in a plastic cup, not in a glass?
G: I’m so hungry, but there’s no food at home.
G: I’m sorry, but I don’t want to go out now.
Can you please go to a restaurant and pick up some food?

_evidence_text: G: I’d like a banana smoothie, please.
items.statement_en: The girl asked for a smoothie made with bananas.

items.statement_ko: 남자는 여기서 먹을 것인지 가져갈 것인지 물었다.
_evidence_text: M: For here or to go?
items.statement_en: The man wanted to know if she would eat there or take it away.

items.why_ko: 소녀는 'For here'라고 하여 매장에서 먹겠다고 했다.
items.statement_en: The girl said she would take the drink out with her.

items.statement_ko: 소녀는 음료를 유리컵에 담아 달라고 부탁했다.
items.why_ko: 유리컵이 아니라 플라스틱 컵에 담아 달라고 했다.
_evidence_text: And can you please put it in a plastic cup, not in a glass?
items.statement_en: The girl asked the man to serve her drink in a glass.

items.statement_ko: 소녀는 배가 고픈데 집에 먹을 것이 없다고 말했다.
_evidence_text: G: I’m so hungry, but there’s no food at home.
items.statement_en: The girl said she was very hungry and there was nothing to eat at home.

items.statement_ko: 소년은 집에 음식이 없다는 사실을 전혀 모르고 있었다.
items.why_ko: 소년은 'I know.'라고 하며 이미 알고 있음을 나타냈다.
items.statement_en: The boy had no idea that there was no food in the house.
The boy suggested that they go out and eat.

items.statement_ko: 소녀는 지금 밖에 나가고 싶어 하지 않는다.
items.why_ko: 미안하지만 지금은 나가고 싶지 않다고 했다.
_evidence_text: G: I’m sorry, but I don’t want to go out now.
items.statement_en: The girl does not feel like going outside right now.

items.statement_ko: 소녀는 소년에게 식당에 가서 음식을 받아 와 달라고 부탁했다.
items.why_ko: 식당에 가서 음식을 픽업해 달라고 부탁했다.
_evidence_text: Can you please go to a restaurant and pick up some food?
items.statement_en: The girl asked the boy to get some food from a restaurant and bring it home.
The boy said no to what the girl asked him to do.
The boy gladly agreed, saying it was no problem.
